summary: Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass against deployed preview URL covering auth (signup/login/social/me/theme), stocks (quote/candles/search/universe), predictions (shallow/deep/movers/screener), watchlist & alerts CRUD, subscription upgrade. Frontend: Expo web preview loads on mobile viewport (390x844), demo login -> dashboard works, sentiment gauge + top movers render, tab navigation (Dashboard/Screener/Watchlist/Alerts/Settings) functional, Screener filters render, Stock detail (/stock/AAPL) shows chart + AI prediction card + indicators. CRITICAL silent LLM failure detected via backend logs.

critical.issue: LLM call ALWAYS fails silently with: 'LlmChat' object has no attribute 'with_max_tokens'. Server returns 200 but uses the static fallback narrative ('Statistical model projects ... with NN% confidence.'), so users never receive real Claude Sonnet 4.5 analysis. Confirmed in stock detail UI which shows the fallback string verbatim. Fix: remove the .with_max_tokens(700) call in server.py:331 (emergentintegrations LlmChat does not expose that method) — use system_message length / max_tokens kwarg supported by the lib instead, or omit it.

minor.issue: EmailStr (pydantic v2 / email-validator) rejects .test TLD. Not a backend bug per se, but worth documenting for QA test data.

integration_issues.issue: Because LLM call silently falls back, narrative/key_factors/risks shown on /stock/[symbol] are generic placeholders, not real AI output. UX impact: high — the headline value-prop ('AI-driven market forecasts') is not actually being delivered.

issues: On web, social sign-in uses an auto-generated email (no Alert.prompt) — this is intentional per spec but main agent should ensure a tooltip/notice indicates this so QA isn't confused.

react_native_issues.issue: Web logs show 'AsyncStorageError: Native module is null, cannot access legacy storage' on first paint and a version mismatch warning (@react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 installed, Expo expects 2.2.0). App still functions because the catch block clears the token, but theme persistence + remembered login may be broken on web. Recommend: `yarn add @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@2.2.0` to align with Expo SDK.
Deprecation warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — refactor Image components to use the resizeMode prop directly.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): Remove or replace `.with_max_tokens(700)` chain in server.py llm_analysis() — emergentintegrations LlmChat has no such method, so deep=true never reaches Claude. Verify by tailing backend logs while hitting /api/predictions/AAPL?deep=true (should NOT log 'LLM analysis failed').
FIX: Pin @react-native-async-storage/async-storage to 2.2.0 (`yarn add @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@2.2.0`) to silence the native-module-null error and align with Expo SDK.
Cleanup: replace deprecated style.resizeMode / props.pointerEvents usages.
Optional: Surface a small UI hint on web auth screen explaining auto-generated social email.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:331 uses an unsupported .with_max_tokens(700) builder method on LlmChat — silently caught by the broad try/except in llm_analysis, masking the failure. Either replace with the supported max_tokens kwarg/method or drop it.

server.py llm_analysis except block is too broad (`except Exception`) which hides real bugs (as in the with_max_tokens case). Consider logging the traceback and/or returning an `llm_used: false` flag so the UI can distinguish real LLM output from fallback.
POST /api/predictions/screener accepts a free-form dict instead of a Pydantic model — input validation is weaker than other endpoints.
/api/predictions/top/movers and /screener compute predictions for all 20 tickers sequentially per request; consider a 30-60s in-memory cache to reduce latency on dashboard refresh.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 endpoints respond correctly), but deep LLM path is functionally broken (returns fallback)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (auth + dashboard + screener + stock detail + tab nav all work; AI narrative shows fallback text due to backend bug)

Also re-run /app/backend/tests/test_api.py end-to-end.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: LlmChat from emergentintegrations does not expose a .with_max_tokens(...) builder method. The chained call .with_model(...).with_max_tokens(700) raises AttributeError BEFORE any message is sent. The wrapping `try/except Exception` in llm_analysis catches it and returns the static fallback dict, so the API still returns 200 but with placeholder content. Reproduce: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' '<url>/api/predictions/AAPL?deep=true'` and observe backend log: `LLM analysis failed for AAPL: 'LlmChat' object has no attribute 'with_max_tokens'`. Mitigation: drop the .with_max_tokens(700) call, or pass max_tokens via the constructor / supported method per emergentintegrations API.
